citations.quote: Campus Room Booking: Project Brief
Prepared by the Facilities Office, Northfield College.
## Background
## Goals
## In scope for the first release
## Open points
# Kickoff meeting: Campus Room Booking
Attendees: Dana Ruiz (Facilities Manager, project sponsor), Sam Okafor (Student Union representative), Priya Nair (IT developer), Alex Kim (product owner).
Today we agree what goes into the first release of room booking.

statements.summary: Current manual tracking leads to double bookings and lack of visibility.

citations.quote: Requests are tracked in a shared spreadsheet, double bookings happen several times a week, and nobody can see which rooms are free without asking.

statements.summary: Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.

citations.quote: Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.

statements.summary: Reduce double bookings to zero by rejecting overlapping bookings for the same room.

citations.quote: Reduce double bookings to zero.
The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

statements.summary: Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.

citations.quote: Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.

statements.summary: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

statements.summary: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

statements.summary: There is a conflict between the brief stating a 4-hour limit and Facilities wanting a 3-hour maximum limit.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.
The brief says four hours, but three hours is the most I want for a single booking, or rooms get hogged.

statements.summary: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

statements.summary: What happens when someone cannot attend a booking, including cancellation times and no-shows.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking.
What happens if a student books a room and doesn't turn up?
We need a rule for no-shows, and for how late someone can cancel, but I have to check with Student Services first.
Okay, cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms.

statements.summary: Recurring bookings are out of scope for release one.

citations.quote: Not in the first release. Recurring bookings make the clash rules much harder, so let's leave recurring bookings out for now and revisit after launch.
Recurring reservations are out of scope for release one.

statements.summary: Syncing bookings to people's Outlook calendars is proposed as a nice-to-have feature.

citations.quote: Maybe we could also sync bookings to people's Outlook calendars? It might be nice.
Possibly, but let's not commit to that today.

statements.summary: The Facilities office needs to see who booked each room, but students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

citations.quote: Also, my office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

items.title: Room Searching and Booking
items.description: Allow students and staff to search for rooms, sign in, and book study slots without double bookings.

items.title: Facilities Room Management
items.description: Provide the Facilities Office with visibility, maintenance control, and management over all room bookings.

items.title: College Account Sign-In
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to sign in with my existing college account, so that I can access the room booking system.

criteria.text: When a user attempts to sign in with valid college credentials, authentication succeeds and access is granted.

items.title: Room Search and Slot Booking
items.description: As a user, I want to search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot, so that I can secure a study space.

criteria.text: When a user searches rooms by date, time, and capacity, the system displays available rooms matching the search.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

criteria.text: When a user books an individual one-off slot, the booking is successfully created.

items.title: Free Room Visibility and Conflict Prevention
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to see which study rooms are free and book one themselves, so that double bookings are reduced to zero.

criteria.text: When a user checks room availability, free study rooms are displayed.

citations.quote: Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.

criteria.text: When an overlapping booking is attempted for the same room, the booking service rejects an overlapping booking for the same room.

citations.quote: The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

items.title: Single View of Bookings for Facilities
items.description: As a member of the Facilities Office, I want a single view of all bookings, so that I can oversee all room reservations.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office accesses the dashboard, a single view of all bookings is displayed.

items.title: Block Room for Maintenance
items.description: As a member of the Facilities Office, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that users cannot book unavailable rooms.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office blocks a room for maintenance, that room becomes unavailable for booking during the specified period.

items.title: Role-Based Booking Details Visibility
items.description: As a staff member of the Facilities Office, I need to see who booked each room while students should only see that a room is taken, so that privacy is maintained while administrative oversight is enabled.

criteria.text: When a user with Facilities Office privileges views a room booking, the user who booked it is displayed.

citations.quote: my office needs to see who booked each room.

criteria.text: When a student views a booked room, the system indicates that the room is taken without revealing who took it.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

questions.subject: Booking Duration Limit
questions.question: Should the maximum duration for a single booking be 4 hours as stated in the brief, or 3 hours as requested by Facilities?
questions.why_it_matters: It directly impacts validation rules and prevents rooms from being hogged versus complying with the initial brief.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.
The brief says four hours, but three hours is the most I want for a single booking, or rooms get hogged.

questions.subject: Cancellation and No-Shows Policy
questions.question: What are the exact rules for no-shows and how late someone can cancel a booking?
questions.why_it_matters: Without this policy, rooms may continue to sit empty all afternoon and penalties or automated cancellations cannot be implemented.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking.
What happens if a student books a room and doesn't turn up?
We need a rule for no-shows, and for how late someone can cancel, but I have to check with Student Services first.
Okay, cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms.
